rationale: The change is limited to the driver-warning presentation component (new visual layout and notification presentation). The supplied description explicitly states that obstacle information, object category information, ego-object spatial information, the Phenomenon of Interest, and the Evaluation Target are unchanged. No supported dependency from this architectural presentation change to H1-ORR1, H1-ORR2, or H1-ORR3 is established in the frozen baseline, so no revalidation or rederivation is required.
